from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CaseDetails(BaseModel):
    """Extracted details from a single judgment document to enable matching against result options."""
    parties: list[str] = Field(description="Names of appellants, appellees, or other litigants mentioned")
    case_numbers: list[str] = Field(description="Case reference numbers found in the document")
    fees: list[str] = Field(description="Fee amounts and descriptions (e.g., '二审受理费 4462 元')")
    compensation_amounts: list[str] = Field(description="Specific monetary amounts awarded or involved in the dispute")
    court_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the court issuing the judgment or ruling")
    outcome_statement: str | None = Field(description="The key conclusion text (e.g., '驳回上诉，维持原判', '驳回复议申请')")
    cause_of_action: str | None = Field(description="The type of dispute (e.g., '返还原物纠纷', '继承纠纷')")
    key_quote: str | None = Field(description="A short verbatim excerpt confirming the outcome or amount")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    case_details: list[CaseDetails]
